findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not affinity-head derivatives.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for the current study.

Continuous contrast functions are evaluated only on observed nodes (method observed_node_linear) with extrapolation disallowed and polynomial fits not accepted; several landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so a constant rule is not supported over the observed window.

Landmark local displacement and curvature features show large first-to-last rate reversals (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative, last_rate_z positive) with relative node RMSE up to ~0.78, indicating time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate behavior within the observed support.

hypotheses.direction: increase temporal_region blend toward observed-node contrast changes
hypotheses.falsifier: no improvement in relative node RMSE or persistent sign conflicts after time-conditioning
hypotheses.observable: landmark local displacement/curvature contrast features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe that modulates landmark attention at observed score nodes using validated absolute contrast changes would track the observed sign reversals better than a static regional rule.

hypotheses.direction: retain freedom for surrounding coordinates, steer landmark region
hypotheses.falsifier: joint diagnostics show the landmark region adds no information beyond common motion
hypotheses.observable: landmark soft-mass and local curvature contrasts
hypotheses.statement: Landmark soft-mass and local curvature features carry information beyond common global motion, so surrounding coordinates should retain freedom while the landmark region is steered.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst, so no causal selection or affinity-improvement claim is made.
Continuous trends are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed; no extrapolation beyond [0.0,0.5] is supported.
Turnover, pair-kernel and moment diagnostics were not read in this pass and are not asserted.
